name: Estradiol valerate
summarySources: Transfeminine Science, Endocrine Society, UCSF Guidelines
summary: Prodrug ester cleaved rapidly into bioidentical 17β-estradiol in plasma and liver, used widely in oral, sublingual, and injectable depot hormone therapy.
advisory: Estimates are reference ranges only; confirm serum estradiol (E2) and testosterone at trough with laboratory blood work.
doseBasis: Oral dosing undergoes extensive hepatic first-pass conversion to estrone (E1). Sublingual administration bypasses initial first-pass metabolism, yielding higher transient E2 peaks and a shorter half-life.

combinations.note: Commonly paired at 5–12.5 mg/day for synergistic gonadotropin suppression.
Accelerates hepatic clearance and lowers steady-state serum estradiol.

pharmacology.text: Estradiol valerate is an estradiol ester, or a prodrug of estradiol. As such, it is an estrogen, or an agonist of the estrogen receptors. The affinity of estradiol valerate for the estrogen receptor is approximately 50 times lower than that of estradiol. In addition, estradiol valerate is rapidly cleaved into estradiol and is unable to reach target tissues in concentrations of significance, if at all.

body.says: Cleavage via esterases in the liver, blood, and tissues
Estradiol, valeric acid, and metabolites of estradiol

uses.text: Estradiol valerate (EV), sold for use by mouth under the brand name Progynova and for use by injection under the brand names Delestrogen and Progynon Depot among others, is an estrogen medication. It is used in hormone therapy for menopausal symptoms and low estrogen levels, hormone therapy for transgender people, and in hormonal birth control. It is also used in the treatment of prostate cancer.
uses.routes: By mouth, sublingual, intramuscular injection, subcutaneous injection

sideEffects.text: Side effects of estradiol valerate include breast tenderness, breast enlargement, nausea, headache, and fluid retention.

summaryZh: 戊酸雌二醇（英語：Estradiol valerate，縮寫為EV）是一種人工合成的經化學修飾的雌激素，由雌二醇經戊酸酯化而成。
